Joining a Conversation Discussion

Badge

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This badge recognizes your engagement in the “Joining a Conversation” discussion by trying out the Atwoodian Table yourself and connecting with colleagues about the experience. By sharing your thinking and responding to others, you help our community explore how students can enter, map, and contribute to conversations across texts.

Criteria

To earn the Joining a Conversation discussion badge, be sure your participation includes:

  • Post in the Joining a Conversation Discussion your completed Atwoodian Table, shared as an uploaded image in the discussion.

  • A brief reflection describing your experience creating the table and how you might use the approach with your students.

  • Thoughtful engagement with colleagues by responding to at least two other teachers’ posts.
